About This Project

🎓 Event Management System (React)

A modern, responsive single-page application built with React. It allows users to create, manage, view, update, delete and register for events — with all data stored persistently in the browser using LocalStorage.

  • React — component-based UI with hooks and Context API
  • React Router — client-side page navigation
  • CSS3 — responsive layout, animations, light/dark theme
  • LocalStorage — persistent data across refreshes

No backend or database required. Runs entirely in the browser.
